signals.text: Kavento Vale was launched on 1 May 2510. The manual contains installation instructions.
On 2 May 2511, Navelto Labs launched Orelina Frame.
Belinto Systems introduced Tivento Leaf on 3 May 2512.
MGate launched on 4 May 2513.
Dovento Desk was introduced on 5 May 2514.
Elinto Prism has been launched as of 6 May 2515.
Availability timeline
Parelina Loop went live as of 7 May 2516.
Zivento Patch rolled out on 8 May 2517.
Larelina Bay was rolled out on 9 May 2518, according to the release record.
Servento Dial is generally available as of 10 May 2519.
Novento Ring is now generally available as of 11 May 2520.
Carinto Track became generally available on 12 May 2521. The release record links a guide.
Yervento Tools has made Varelina Slate generally available on 13 May 2522.
Fervento Shelf entered general availability on 14 May 2523.
Arel.Dev Board 5.3 reached GA on 15 May 2524.
